source_title: Gracie Abrams, Dominic Fike, Daddy Yankee, and All the Songs You Need to Know This Week
source_excerpt:
Welcome to our weekly rundown of the best new music — featuring big singles, key tracks from our favorite albums, and more. This week, Gracie Abrams gives us a taste of fury from the deluxe edition of Daughter From Hell , Cardi B joins Daddy Yankee for sultry bachata, and Dominic Fike calls up indie rocker Grace Ives for a soulful cut from his newest project. Plus, new tunes from Queens of the Stone Age, MJ Lenderman, Justice, Yves, and Everything But the Girl.
